DRAE 2001, del inglés. En los medios educativos que más directamente influyen sobre nosotros se impuso la tesis del conductismo de que el aprendizaje es modificación del comportamiento producto de estímulos yrefuerzos positivos y negativos. 1.en_consolidated_definition:
Psychol. Discipline and methodology that studies the behavior of stimulus-response relationships in conduct. Anglicism with a rare sense, infrequent usage. From English.

In educational media that most directly influence us, the thesis of behaviorism was imposed, which states that learning is modification of behavior resulting from positive and negative stimuli and reinforcements. Behaviorism rejects thinking and working with structures and processes that may underlie these changes and stimuli, and considers the psychological as an impenetrable black box for scientific investigation.
